title_original: The Film Comment Podcast: Sex in the Cinema at NYFF64
excerpt_original: Ayanna Dozier and Melissa Anderson join to discuss several films from this year’s lineup that push the boundaries of sensuality and desire on screen

blocks.text: Several films—both old and new—across this year’s NYFF lineup push the boundaries of depictions of sensuality and desire on screen, posing provocative questions for the current cinema landscape, where sex has become a divisive subject.

Last Tuesday at the festival, filmmaker and scholar Ayanna Dozier and Film Comment Contributing Editor Melissa Anderson joined F ilm Comment Editors Devika Girish and Clinton Krute to explore films like Nitrate Kisses , The Devils , The Drift , The Unknown , and others to discuss what thrills and terrifies us about sexuality on screen.
This episode is sponsored by Criterion .
